job_triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER generation_batch_job_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.core_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION quillmd_batch_job_guard()
job_triggers.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quillmd_batch_job_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.kind='generation_part' AND (NEW.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_key
 OR (OLD.result_path<>'' AND (NEW.result_path IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.result_path OR NEW.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.result_sha256)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'A batch attempt or recorded result cannot be replaced'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

job_triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER job_disposition BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.core_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION quillmd_disposition_reference()
CREATE TRIGGER job_financial_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON public.core_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION quillmd_job_financial_guard()
job_triggers.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quillmd_job_financial_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
            BEGIN
              IF NEW.config IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.config OR (OLD.payer <> '' AND NEW.payer IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payer)
              THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authorized job pricing and payer are immutable'; END IF;
              RETURN NEW;
            END; $function$

job_triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER job_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.core_job FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION quillmd_preservation_no_truncate()
job_triggers.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quillmd_preservation_no_truncate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preservation and clinical records cannot be truncated'; END; $function$
